title.zh: 第 17 章 排列與組合

intro.zh: 第 17 章分三節：17.1 計數基本原理、17.2 排列、17.3 組合。三節的課本練習都已提供逐步題解：先學「分類用加、分步用乘」，再學排列（有次序），最後學組合（不計次序）。章末另有「17 快測」（5 題，即時對錯）同「17 測前溫習」（4 題多項選擇 ＋ 6 題長題目，共 30 分，改編自 EPH《Level 5 Assurance Pack》WS22 工作紙），考前可以用來總溫習。
intro.en: Chapter 17 has three sections: 17.1 basic counting principles, 17.2 permutations and 17.3 combinations. All three sections now have step-by-step solutions: first add for cases and multiply for steps, then permutations (order matters) and finally combinations (order ignored). At the end of the chapter there are also '17 Quick Check' (5 questions with instant feedback) and '17 Pre-test Revision' (4 multiple-choice and 6 conventional questions, 30 marks), adapted from the EPH Level 5 Assurance Pack WS22 worksheet, for final revision before the test.

title.zh: 第 18 章 概率的進一步認識

intro.zh: 第 18 章分四節：18.1 集合、18.2 概率的加法定律、18.3 概率的乘法、18.4 概率與計數。四節的課本練習（Exercise 18.1 至 18.4）已全部上線；各節標題以課本為準，有需要會再校正。
intro.en: Chapter 18 has four sections: 18.1 sets, 18.2 the addition law of probability, 18.3 multiplication of probabilities and 18.4 probability by counting. The book exercises for all four sections (Exercise 18.1 to 18.4) are now online. Section titles follow the textbook and may be adjusted later.

comingSoon.zh: 之後會陸續加入其他章節測驗、課本練習與考試檢討 —— 資料放在 data/src/，加一個檔案就可以。第 17 章三節、第 18 章四節已全部上線。
comingSoon.en: More chapter tests, classwork and exam reviews will be added; each part is a single file in data/src/. All three sections of Chapter 17 and all four sections of Chapter 18 are online.
